## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts

- **Phishing fraud exploiting Microsoft outage:** Hackers are sending fake Microsoft technical support emails claiming to resolve recent Outlook disruptions to steal corporate credentials. **What to do:** Never click password reset links in unsolicited emails; check status updates directly on official admin dashboards. [[India Today]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5)
- **WhatsApp "Digital Arrest" scam:** Fraudsters posing as police officers contact citizens via WhatsApp video, threatening arrest for alleged illegal parcels or hawala transactions. **What to do:** Police agencies never conduct investigations or demand funds via video call; hang up immediately and report to 1930. [[The Indian Express]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Daily Pioneer]](https://news.google.?oc=5)

## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Current Account Deficit (CAD):** A Current Account Deficit occurs when a country's total spending on foreign trade (imported goods, services, and transfers) exceeds its income from foreign trade. For example, even though India recorded a record $90 billion in exports in October, higher spending on imported oil and gold created a trade gap. When the CAD widens, a country relies on foreign investment or foreign exchange reserves to protect the domestic currency. [[The Indian EYE]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNaG1nUDA4X1VWWlR2YmYtQWNSMEtwVkIwUTk1SlZDeFdYUUdpd2xzQ1B0N1JKZzN2eVRqUjF3OWVnUFUybnlRZVpMX1pmd3YxMWJxZDdPSHB4MTJObHhlWWtvd3FORFV6VXdULVg5bnlDcUctM1NMakYxWlBuU19IMWZ1Ykt3OEhJLUVjWWxURjJxS09EazVXangtUVZfZE9pWnZ1RUpIU0o1MHozMUtvWjVMcmFWMVhPMVRkeUttS1FKaGlrOVE?oc=5) [[News On AIR]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQVXI3bjg0enpiTEJhRmtZNVFodEdlcWpSc21kZFZKbmpJc0R1Z1lpZ0JGT1AydlJqRkpnVkR5T2xfUDdGWV9MWU1KclFLZkdkdmhvOUZrdDl0MG1keHBLZmluX0N1SXZrSTR3NXZfa3hyLWVmZDdIenl5SC1qU1EyN29yemNnendoRUNDSXpWMG5IcWVnci1HTk5wZkRnUQ?oc=5) [[Times Now]](https://news.google.?oc=5)
